svg.aria-label: TrainCache Architecture — preheat and scheduling wired into one loop
svg.text: TrainCache Architecture — preheat and scheduling wired into one loop
The Agent writes blocks to node-local disk; training Pods read from that disk. The controller only decides when to release a Pod and which node it is placed on.
side-channel only, never on a data path
owners differ; existing systems cover phase 1 only
data contract, block space fixed once
The Agent is never on the read path
reads hit local disk plus page cache, zero added latency
the cost: read signals are sampled out-of-band
controller owns it, high priority, blocks the gate
times out and degrades; training is not blocked
Agent owns it, low priority, interruptible
degrades to a plain origin read
DataLoader hook owns it, yields to the new job
short spike, then the next phase runs steady
